name: Galaxy Grand

images.credit: Ardinugraha04, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: EDGE / GPRS (850 / 900 / 1,800 / 1,900 MHz), HSPA+ 21 / 5.76 Mbp/s (Global) LTE (South Korea) CDMA2000 EV-DO Rev.A (800 MHz (China Telecom), Band 4 1.8 GHz (LG U+), TD-SCDMA 1900, 2000 MHz (China Mobile)

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 4.1.2 "Jelly Bean", Current: Android 4.2.2, Updatable with custom rom: LineageOS 14.1 (Android 7.1.2 "Nougat")
Platform.Chipset: Broadcom BCM 28155 (Global), Qualcomm Snapdragon 400 MSM8X (2 & 6) 25 (China TD-SCDMA & CDMA), Samsung Exynos 4412 (Korea)
Platform.CPU: 1.2 GHz Cortex-A9 dual-core and 1.2 GHz quad-core (Korea) and Qualcomm kriat 1.2 GHz (China)
Platform.GPU: Broadcom VideoCore IV VPU (global), ARM Mali-400 MP4 440 MHz GPU (Korea), Adreno 305 GPU (China)

Display.Display: 5.0 inch TFT LCD, 800×480 px WVGA (~187 ppi)

Cameras.Rear camera: 8 MP 1080p Full HD video recording @ 30fps with auto-focus; self-timer; panorama; smile shot; face detection; stop motion

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 4.0, micro-USB 2.0, Wi-Fi (802.11a/b/g/n), Wi-Fi Direct, FM radio with RDS (Global), DMB Mobile TV (Korean), A-GPS and GLONASS
